correctness.rationale: The principal-mode secular equation reduces exactly to a monotone scalar equation in N times the eigenfrequency; exact trigonometric sums give the finite-N DCT overlap, and its limits yield the stated phase transition. Dense eigendecomposition checks agree with the closed-form formulas.

originality.rationale: Classical fixed-N KLT-to-DCT limits, sinusoidal-family asymptotic equivalence, AR(1) eigenformulas, and continuum exponential-covariance KL theory are excluded from novelty. No checked source or SCOPE record gives the explicit growing-block principal-overlap law, the iff N(1-rho) criterion, or the corresponding nonuniformity obstruction for the new exact DCT-core factorization.

value.rationale: The result identifies block length divided by correlation length as a sharp geometric control parameter for whether a DCT core approximates the leading AR(1) KLT mode, and shows that correction factors cannot be discarded uniformly over growing block sizes.
